source_permutation_plan: Primary rotation only, full registered refitting budget; shuffle drug correspondence jointly in T/NK. Preserve target anchors and controls. Report each method, not only selected winners. Fixed before public read; predictions for these negative controls may be executed after opening public but no decisions may depend on public results.

additional_metric_registered_before_publ.name: plate_orthogonal_mse
additional_metric_registered_before_publ.definition: H[p,b] is the fraction of public drug p target replicates in plate b, based ONLY on metadata. M=I-H*pinv(H). Score norm(M*(prediction-truth))^2 / ((n-rank(H))*G).
additional_metric_registered_before_publ.rationale: An estimated effect equals mean treated log-abundance minus H times control means. M eliminates the shared plate-control nuisance exactly. This changes the estimand to within-design contrasts and cannot assess absolute average effects.
additional_metric_registered_before_publ.independence_limit: Disjoint physical control wells do not establish independence across donor/library/plate effects; no independent donor or causal claim.
additional_metric_registered_before_publ.pre_registration_audit_note: Before protocol, train/control value ranges and row sums were checked for count integrity. Final control vectors were not used for model development. Private/public treatment expression remained unread.

limitations: Globally prefiltered gene panel uses all contexts before split; not a pristine inductive gene-universe benchmark
Same treated PBMC wells across source and target may share assay/culture variation
No explicit donor IDs or independent study validation
Observed target is log retained-library abundance, not signed significance or absolute RNA per cell
No latest deep-model comparison or superiority claim
